tasks.title: Specification: Research prior art, existing ADRs and memory

executor.requirement: researcher: what already exists (code, ADRs, memory patterns) and what is reusable, with sources

tasks.title: Specification: Specify the requirements and acceptance criteria

executor.requirement: specification: a written specification with testable acceptance criteria

tasks.title: Architecture: Design the architecture and interfaces

executor.requirement: architecture: modules, interfaces and data flow, with the decisions recorded

tasks.title: Architecture: Record the decisions as ADRs and write the SOP

executor.requirement: adr-architect: an ADR per decision and a short SOP for running and changing it, linked from the code

tasks.title: Pseudocode: Write the pseudocode for the core logic

executor.requirement: pseudocode: step-by-step logic covering every acceptance criterion

tasks.title: Refinement: Write the failing tests first

executor.requirement: tester: tests that fail for the right reason before the change

tasks.title: Refinement: Implement until the tests pass

executor.requirement: coder: the change, with the new tests passing and no others broken
performance-engineer: measurements no worse than the baseline
reviewer: a review with every finding resolved or accepted

tasks.title: Refinement: Run the full test suite

executor.requirement: tester: the whole suite green, the output kept as evidence
cicd-engineer: the build and CI checks pass
api-docs: the docs match the shipped behaviour

tasks.title: Completion: Validate the result against the goal

executor.requirement: production-validator: every acceptance criterion checked by something other than the author

tasks.title: Completion: Learn: store the outcome and self-optimize

executor.requirement: reasoningbank-learner: the outcome stored as patterns (memory and trajectory) and routing trained on it, so the next mission starts better

acceptance.check: a specification exists and every requirement has a testable acceptance criterion
the design is written down: modules, interfaces and decisions
the whole test suite passes, including the new tests
every acceptance criterion is checked by something other than the author
prior art, existing ADRs and memory are searched and what is reusable is recorded
the outcome is stored as patterns and routing is trained on it
review findings are resolved or explicitly accepted
each decision is an ADR and a short SOP says how to run and change it
measurements are no worse than the baseline
